text:
alex: Heads-up — starting v2 rollout in the 22:00 UTC change window. Canary wave now. Release notes updated (short note about stricter header normalization). /deploy start v2 --wave=canary

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployment started for v2 (canary id c-1729). Rolling to 10%.

emily: seeing a spike of 502s from EU edge during canary, digging into logs now. /logs shard-eu | grep v2 — brief tail shows a lot of `InvalidHeader` traces.

ops-bot: ops-bot: alert created #INC-12345 — 5xx rate increased on canary hosts (eu-west). Notified on-call.

maria: Customer support ping — a partner hit a failure in mobile SDK 1.4.2: `InvalidHeaderException: header contains mixed-case bytes`. They started a batch sync and it failed once we switched them to v2.

samir: if this is only hitting mobile SDKs we can avoid a full rollback by pinning mobile traffic to v1. Suggest pausing rollout and flipping mobile route back to v1 while we triage. @alex ok to pause canary?

alex: Pausing canary now. /deploy pause c-1729 :white_flag:

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary c-1729 paused by alex. Traffic halted at 10%.

emily: quick mitigation option: add a relaxed header acceptor for mobile agents at the gateway. config snippet:```
match(client.agent =~ /mobile/i) {
  header_normalize: legacy
}
```This should accept mixed-case headers until SDK bump.

samir: that's fast but a bit hacky state-wise. I'd prefer server-side pinning to v1 for the mobile shard so we avoid special casing. Also we must update release notes to explicitly call out header normalization change and the SDK bump path for customers.

maria: I've opened a rollback runbook and a customer advisory. Rollback plan: route traffic-tag:mobile -> v1 for 24h, notify top-10 impacted customers, and ask mobile SDK team to cut 1.4.3 with tolerant header parsing. PR: git.redwood/release/rollback-mobile-pin (WIP).

alex: OK. Conservative rollback for mobile only. Ops — can you schedule the traffic-shift? Need on-call approval. @ops-bot run shift v1 mobile 100% --dry-run then apply.

ops-bot: ops-bot: dry-run success. No errors. To apply run: `/ops shift apply --route mobile --to v1 --percent 100 --reason 'v2 header incompat'`

emily: Applying now. I'll push the release-notes addendum and customer advisory, include workaround snippet for SDK integrators and a pointer to the rollback PR. :memo:
